payload.name: Human-readable persisted artifacts
payload.statement: Human-authored Projector configuration and canonical artifacts use typed TOML, readable stable identity-derived filenames, deliberate ordering, readable multiline prose, and document-relative local versioned schema directives. Runtime parsing validates the same executable typed contracts without requiring an editor. Semantic and discovery currentness derives from normalized parsed values; exact bytes are bound separately only for reviewed mutation, executable input, and recovery. Machine-owned JSON and derived SQLite remain when useful. Hash agreement establishes no correctness, approval, authorization, fidelity, or provenance.
